name: Web Lurker (BB)

items.name: Spider Speak
items.text: The web lurker can speak with and understand spiders.

items.name: Web Lurker Venom
items.text: A target damaged by the web lurker's fangs must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude save save or take 1d12 poison damage and gain the Off-Guard condition for 1 round.

items.name: Web Trap
items.text: A creature hit by the web lurker's web attack gets stuck to the nearest surface. It can't move until it successfully Escapes.

text: Web lurkers, known also as ettercaps, are ugly monsters that not only dwell within the lairs of spiders and swarms, but actively cultivate and shepherd such vermin. Web lurkers hunt in forests, swamps, or scrubby hill lands. They construct structures from their webs high up in trees or within craggy, high canyons, and they surround their territory with traps constructed of the same webbing and natural material.
